notes: Nyaa searches now use a bounded time budget and shorter network timeouts, preventing multi-minute waits caused by long episode-discovery queries.
Added Cancel search with immediate UI recovery; new searches can start without waiting for the old request, and stale search results cannot override the new search.
AllDebrid preparation can be cancelled from its progress dialog, title-bar X or Downloads while preserving existing downloaded files.
Late AllDebrid upload/status/file responses no longer revive cancelled preparations; duplicate status polling is prevented.
Uncached AllDebrid releases that stay pending for more than 3 minutes now show a clear preparation error instead of waiting indefinitely.
